$comment: HAND-EDITED source of Machines > Machine Colors (cx-d5b5d). scripts/cmux-next/gen-settings-sources.py writes the Swift descriptors and parser constants from it; its docstring is the row format (tabs.json's $comment repeats it, plus choices_from and "swift_case": null). Lists: SettingsSchema.all concatenates them, so rows keep the export's order; schemas/settings/settings-schema.json must not change when rows move here.

rows.note: Drawn by the Machines card (a color per machine), not as a map editor.

help.text: The color of each machine's sidebar rows and tab badges, by machine name: "#RRGGBB", or an accent name (red, green, yellow, purple, cyan, orange, pink, blue) that follows the theme. A machine without one gets a color from its name.
